user.title: Brick Hub
user.description: Brick your iPhone from any Home Assistant trigger. You can change these later, but never while bricked.

data.auto_request_reset: Start the reset automatically when they run out
data.tag_toggles: Scanning a brick tag while unbricked bricks the phone

data_description.emergency_max: How many emergency unbricks you get before needing a reset.
data_description.reset_hours: How long a reset takes to refill your emergency unbricks (48 h = 2 days).
data_description.strict: Refuse unbricks from a button press. Only a brick tag, a timer, an automation or an emergency unbrick can end a brick.

abort.already_configured: Brick Hub is already set up.

data.auto_request_reset: Start the reset automatically when they run out
data.tag_toggles: Scanning a brick tag while unbricked bricks the phone

data_description.emergency_max: Raising this does not refill your emergency unbricks; only a completed reset does.

push.title: Push to iPhone (APNs)
push.description: Optional but recommended: lets Home Assistant wake the iPhone app the moment a trigger fires. Use an APNs auth key (.p8) from your Apple Developer account.

error.apns_incomplete: Fill in Team ID, Key ID and the key, or leave all three empty.
error.apns_bad_key: That doesn't look like a valid .p8 key.

abort.locked_while_bricked: Settings are locked while you're bricked.

options.silent: Silent background push (iOS may delay it)

brick.name: Brick
brick.description: Block the apps in a mode on your iPhone(s).

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Mode name or id from the app. Defaults to the selected mode.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Unbrick automatically after this long. Leave empty for no time limit.

source.name: Source
source.description: Label shown on the phone, e.g. "Bedtime".

unbrick.name: Unbrick
unbrick.description: Unblock apps. In strict mode only works from automations, not when run by hand.

toggle.name: Toggle
toggle.description: Brick if unbricked, unbrick if bricked.

request_emergency_reset.name: Request emergency reset
request_emergency_reset.description: Start the countdown that refills your emergency unbricks.

add_tag.name: Add brick tag
add_tag.description: Register an NFC tag (UID or Home Assistant tag id) as a brick. Not allowed while bricked.

tag_id.name: Tag ID
tag_id.description: Tag UID or HA tag id.

remove_tag.name: Remove brick tag
remove_tag.description: Forget a brick tag. Not allowed while bricked.

tag_id.name: Tag ID
tag_id.description: Tag UID or HA tag id.
